dataset.name: Current campaigns House and Senate summary file
dataset.description: FEC processed financial summary rows for current House and Senate campaigns, using the same physical columns as the all-candidates summary but a distinct publisher population.

acquisition.pagination: None. Each requested two-year period is one complete ZIP snapshot.

partitions.name: two_year_period
partitions.source: Requested bulk URL path; cycle_suffix is the period's final two digits.
partitions.purpose: Acquisition, reconciliation, and replay boundary. It does not replace the row-level CVG_END_DT.

acquisition.retry_policy: Bound retries for transport failures; follow redirects; publish only after validating the HTTP result, ZIP integrity, exact substituted member name, archive digest, row width, and record count.

physical_schema.line_ending: LF with a required final LF in the verified 2020, 2022, 2024, and 2026 artifacts
physical_schema.empty_record_policy: An empty physical line becomes an explicit record-boundary issue; it is never silently skipped.
physical_schema.null_policy: Preserve empty fields as empty strings and numeric lexemes exactly as published. Empty, zero, and negative values are distinct; no source value is converted through binary floating point.
physical_schema.schema_fingerprint: The official FEC file-format table enumerates these 30 ordered positions: CAND_ID|CAND_NAME|CAND_ICI|PTY_CD|CAND_PTY_AFFILIATION|TTL_RECEIPTS|TRANS_FROM_AUTH|TTL_DISB|TRANS_TO_AUTH|COH_BOP|COH_COP|CAND_CONTRIB|CAND_LOANS|OTHER_LOANS|CAND_LOAN_REPAY|OTHER_LOAN_REPAY|DEBTS_OWED_BY|TTL_INDIV_CONTRIB|CAND_OFFICE_ST|CAND_OFFICE_DISTRICT|SPEC_ELECTION|PRIM_ELECTION|RUN_ELECTION|GEN_ELECTION|GEN_ELECTION_PRECENT|OTHER_POL_CMTE_CONTRIB|POL_PTY_CONTRIB|CVG_END_DT|INDIV_REFUNDS|CMTE_REFUNDS

identity.occurrence_locator: archive SHA-256 + exact member name + one-based physical line number
identity.record_version: occurrence locator + SHA-256 of the exact source line
identity.duplicate_policy: Preserve every physical occurrence. A repeated candidate key with conflicting content blocks any singleton summary projection.

time_fields.meaning: Requested FEC bulk period and acquisition boundary.
Coverage end date for this specific campaign summary row; never infer it from the archive name.

money_fields.meaning: Source-reported cash on hand at the beginning of the period.
Source-reported cash on hand at the close of the period.
Source-reported debts owed by the committee.
Source-reported contributions from other political committees.
Source-reported individual refunds; negative source values remain negative.

code_fields.meaning: Raw election-status fields; retain each source column separately.

rules: Treat this file as a separate House-and-Senate current-campaign population, not as a newer or interchangeable copy of the all-candidates summary.
Treat each money field as an independent publisher summary assertion; do not assume the published total equals a locally chosen sum of the other columns.
Convert a valid money lexeme losslessly to the common MoneyMeasure reported_point shape while retaining the raw lexeme and source field.
Do not replace itemized transaction facts with these summaries or manufacture itemized contributors from summary categories.
Do not use TTL_RECEIPTS as a fallback for missing graph-attributed receipts; publish coverage differences explicitly.
Authorized-committee transfers can cause double counting when candidate rows or committees are combined; preserve transfer columns and name the aggregation rule.
CVG_END_DT is the row's financial time boundary. The archive period is not a substitute.
Negative reported values are valid evidence and must not be clamped to zero.
The source field is spelled GEN_ELECTION_PRECENT; preserve that physical name even if a semantic projection later exposes a corrected label.

revisions.publisher_model: The FEC regenerates this processed current-campaign file from reports. The file has no row-level amendment chain or revision identifier.
revisions.effective_projection: Blocked while draft. Preserve every acquired snapshot. A latest view is selected per candidate using a named population, snapshot, and CVG_END_DT policy.

checks.rule: The archive digest, requested period, exact substituted member, retrieval time, and response metadata are present.
Every physical line has exactly 30 fields; short rows are not padded and extra fields are not truncated.
Every source byte decodes under the accepted encoding; invalid bytes are retained as failed raw evidence, never silently dropped.
Every non-empty money field parses losslessly as a signed decimal without binary floating point.
Every non-empty CVG_END_DT parses strictly as the source date format and remains attached to its row.
Record counts and office codes are compared with prior snapshots; this file's current-campaign population is not silently broadened to all candidates.
Every non-empty physical line becomes one record occurrence or one explicit issue.
Conflicting records for one CAND_ID and source period remain separate and block a singleton projection.
The ordered 30-field header must match the positions in the cited official FEC file-format table.
Member name, field order, or field count changes require contract review.

use.retention: Retain the exact archive, HTTP metadata, archive digest, member inventory, record occurrences, and issues indefinitely; every derived summary remains rebuildable.
use.disclaimer: These are processed FEC summary assertions for the current House-and-Senate campaign population with row-specific coverage dates. They are not itemized transactions and must not be presented as fully attributed terminal-source money.
